description: Main FastAPI application definition for the certification management system. Implements API endpoints for health checks, certification job creation and retrieval, patching, mappings, metadata operations, and webhooks. Configures middleware, dependency injections, background tasks, and logging setup.

classes.name: RequestLoggingMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class for logging HTTP request details and timing.

methods.name: None _background_trigger_orchestration(run_id: str)
methods.description: Background task to trigger orchestration of certification job via external system like Airflow.

methods.name: HealthResponse health_check()
methods.description: Returns health status including database connectivity.

methods.name: CertificationRunResponse create_certification( payload: TriggerCertificationRequest, background_tasks: BackgroundTasks, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), request: Request = None, actor_header: Optional[str] = Depends(extract_actor_from_headers), )
methods.description: API to create a new certification job, persist it, and trigger background orchestration.

methods.name: WebhookAck gitlab_webhook( payload: GitLabWebhookPush, background_tasks: BackgroundTasks, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), x_gitlab_token: Optional[str] = Header(default=None, alias="X-Gitlab-Token"), x_webhook_secret: Optional[str] = Header(default=None, alias="X-Webhook-Secret"), request: Request = None, )
methods.description: Webhook endpoint to trigger certification jobs based on GitLab events, secured via tokens.

methods.name: CertificationRunResponse get_certification( run_id: str, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Retrieve details of certification job by run_id.

methods.name: CertificationRunResponse patch_certification( run_id: str, payload: PatchCertificationRequest, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), request: Request = None, actor_header: Optional[str] = Depends(extract_actor_from_headers), )
